notes.subject: ומבשרי
notes.rationale: Go tšwa nameng (KJV, BSB) kgahlanong le ntle le nama (ASV, JPS) — preposition מ e ka bolela 'go tšwa' goba 'ka ntle le'.

notes.subject: נקפו
notes.rationale: 'ba le gatele' — bafoledi ba kgodiša go 'ba senya' (diboko) goba 'ba dikantša'; lentšu le bolela go betla, go gatelelwa.

notes.subject: אחזה...אחזה
notes.rationale: Go boelediša ga lefoko חזה (go bona/go lebelela) mo lesaleng le le latelago le aga motheo wa poledišano; seo se phelagantšhwe ka go Sepedi.

translation: Gomme ka morago ga letlalo la ka ba le gatele ⟨se⟩, gomme go tšwa nameng ya ka ke tla bona Eloha.

tokens.gloss: gomme go tšwa nameng ya ka
